verdict.rationale: Lever has no CLI or CI runner, but its developer docs show a REST API with OAuth. That API covers creating and listing applications and listing audit events, and webhooks support event-driven integrations, so it can be driven headlessly from scripts or CI jobs. Automation Hub only automates tasks inside the app and does not count as headless execution. Missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK for scripted use, CI/CD-specific guidance or examples, documented service-account or API-key setup for non-interactive runs, and independent or hands-on confirmation of headless automation.
